description: Java entity class representing product reviews in an e-commerce system, including fields for review details, associations to customer and product, and audit information.

classes.name: ProductReview
classes.description: Entity class for product reviews, including review details, associations to customer and product, and audit info.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the product review.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the product review.

methods.name: getReviewRead
methods.description: Returns the number of times the review has been read.

methods.name: setReviewRead
methods.description: Sets the number of times the review has been read.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Returns the customer who made the review.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Sets the customer who made the review.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of review descriptions.

methods.name: getReviewDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the review.

methods.name: setReviewDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the review.
